title: 第 54 章 大长老主动求和第 54 章 大长老主动求和
slug: 我被师姐凌辱你说我罪恶滔天
lines: 一日之后陈默刚在自己的住处修炼完《玄天决》的第一层，门外就传来了敲门声。
他走过去打开门之后就看到一个穿着灰色短衫的年轻小厮站在门口，那小厮看起来机灵得很见到陈默之后连忙躬下了身子。
“陈默师兄，小的奉大长老之命前来请您去府上做客。”小厮说道。
“做客。”陈默的眉头微微挑了一下。
“大长老请我去做什么。”
“大长老说之前有些误会想跟您当面解释清楚。”小厮说道。
“还说之前的事是他听信了两个弟子的胡言乱语，误会了您所以特意让小的来请您过去一趟。”
“想当面给您赔个不是。”
而陈默听到这话之后心中已经明白了七八分，他在心里想着大长老这是怕了？
昨天在通天峰沈清璇跟他拍了桌子，后来又听说自己给了沈清璇灵品丹药，这位大长老估计是被吓住了。
“知道了。”陈默说道。
“我这就跟你去。”
当小厮听到这话之后脸上露出了笑容，他连忙侧身让开一条路然后在前面带路。
而陈默跟在他身后走出了内门穿过外门的几条走廊，一路上不少弟子看到陈默之后都在小声议论。
“那不是陈默吗，大长老的小厮怎么跟他走在一起。”
“你没听说吗大长老请陈默去做客，说是要给他赔罪。”
“大长老给陈默赔罪，我没听错吧。”
“没听错我也听说了，大长老在通天峰被沈长老拍了桌子之后怕了，估计是想跟陈默修好。”
那些弟子们的议论声从四面八方传来，陈默没有理会他们只是跟着小厮继续往前走。
没过多久两人就来到了大长老的府邸门口，比起之前陈默第一次来的时候这里的守卫明显少了不少。
只见小厮推开门然后侧身让陈默先进，陈默大步走了进去。
而大长老正坐在大厅的主位上，看到陈默走进来之后他立刻站起身来脸上堆满了笑容。
那笑容真诚得很，要不是陈默见过他之前的嘴脸恐怕真的会被骗过去。
“陈默贤侄你来了。”大长老快步迎了上来双手握着陈默的手。
“快请坐快请坐，老夫等你好一会儿了。”
而陈默看着他那副热情的样子心中觉得有些好笑，他在心里想着这人变脸的速度还真是快。
“大长老客气了。”陈默淡淡道。
“不知道大长老叫我来所为何事。”
“先坐先坐。”大长老说道。
“咱们坐下慢慢说。”
只见他拉着陈默在椅子上坐下来然后亲自给陈默倒了一杯茶，那殷勤的样子跟之前判若两人。
不过陈默端起茶杯喝了一口没有说话，大长老搓了搓手然后开口了。
“陈默贤侄啊之前的事情是老夫不对。”大长老说道。
“老夫听信了陆云和陆瑶那两个孽徒的一面之词，误会了你实在是抱歉得很。”
“老夫今天请你来就是想当面给你赔个不是，希望你能大人不记小人过原谅老夫之前的冒犯。”
而陈默看着他脸上没有什么表情，他在心里想着这老东西倒是能屈能伸。
content_en:
One day later, just as Chen Mo finished practicing the first level of "Xuan Tian Jue" at his residence, there was a knock on the door.
After he walked over and opened the door, he saw a young man wearing a gray short shirt standing at the door. The young man looked very smart and bowed down quickly when he saw Chen Mo.
"Senior Brother Chen Mo, I am here to invite you to my house as a guest on the order of the elder," the boy said.
"Being a guest." Chen Mo raised his eyebrows slightly.
"What did the great elder ask me to do?"
"The Great Elder said that there were some misunderstandings before and he wanted to explain it to you face to face." the boy said.
"He also said that what happened before was that he listened to the nonsense of two disciples and misunderstood you, so he specially asked the younger one to invite you over."
"I want to apologize to you in person."
After hearing this, Chen Mo already understood something in his heart. He was thinking in his heart, is the Great Elder afraid?
Yesterday, Shen Qingxuan slapped the table with him at Tongtian Peak. Later, he heard that he had given Shen Qingxuan the spiritual elixir. The great elder was probably frightened.
"I know." Chen Mo said.
"I'll go with you right now."
When the boy heard this, a smile appeared on his face. He quickly stepped aside and led the way.
Chen Mo followed him out of the inner door and through the corridors of the outer door. Along the way, many disciples whispered after seeing Chen Mo.
"Isn't that Chen Mo? Why is the great elder's servant walking with him?"
"Didn't you hear that the great elder invited Chen Mo to be a guest and said he wanted to apologize to him?"
"The Great Elder apologized to Chen Mo. Did I hear that right?"
"I heard that right. I heard that the Great Elder was frightened after being slapped on the table by Elder Shen at Tongtian Peak. He probably wanted to make peace with Chen Mo."
The disciples' comments came from all directions, but Chen Mo ignored them and just followed the boy and continued walking forward.
It didn't take long for the two of them to arrive at the entrance of the great elder's mansion. There were obviously fewer guards here than when Chen Mo first came.
The boy opened the door and stepped aside to let Chen Mo go in. Chen Mo strode in.
The Great Elder was sitting at the main seat in the hall. When he saw Chen Mo walking in, he immediately stood up with a smile on his face.
That smile was so sincere that Chen Mo would have been deceived if he hadn't seen his face before.
"Nephew Chen Moxian, you are here." The elder quickly came forward and held Chen Mo's hand with both hands.
"Please have a seat. Please have a seat. I've been waiting for you for a long time."
Chen Mo looked at his enthusiastic look and felt a little funny in his heart. He thought in his heart that this man's face changed really quickly.
"Great Elder, you're welcome." Chen Mo said calmly.
"I don't know why the great elder called me here."
"Sit down first," the great elder said.
"Let's sit down and talk slowly."
I saw him pulling Chen Mo to sit down on the chair and pouring a cup of tea for Chen Mo himself. His attentive look was completely different from before.
However, Chen Mo picked up the tea cup and took a sip without saying anything. The elder rubbed his hands and then spoke.
"Nephew Chen Moxian, what happened before was my fault," the great elder said.
"I believed the two villains Lu Yun and Lu Yao's words and misunderstood you. I'm really sorry."
"I invited you here today because I want to apologize to you in person. I hope you can forgive me for my previous offense."
Chen Mo looked at him with no expression on his face. He thought in his heart that this old guy was quite capable of bending and stretching.
title_en: Chapter 54 The great elder takes the initiative to seek peace Chapter 54 The great elder takes the initiative to seek peace
